metadata.agent_last_message:
Implemented the LAS 1.4 CLI in [output/main.js](/workspace/output/main.js), with the parser/renderer and spec validation in [output/las.js](/workspace/output/las.js) plus small helpers in [output/utils.js](/workspace/output/utils.js) and [output/errors.js](/workspace/output/errors.js). It handles `inspect` and `render`, supports header/VLR/EVLR parsing, CRS records, point formats `0` through `10`, waveform descriptors/data records, and Extra Bytes metadata, and it rejects malformed standard `LASF_Spec` / `LASF_Projection` records instead of downgrading them to opaque data.

I verified it with end-to-end round-trips for:
- WKT + point format 6
- GeoTIFF + legacy point format 3
- Internal waveform data + point format 9

I also checked an invalid render dataset path to confirm it returns `invalid_request` rather than silently accepting inconsistent LAS 1.4 content.
